text: 资本市场波动加大，8月居民存款搬家节奏放缓 非银存款同比少增或指向股市、理财等资管产品赚钱效应不及去年同期。
text_en: Capital market volatility increased, the pace of household deposit relocation slowed in August; non-bank deposits rose less year-on-year, possibly pointing to weaker profit effects in stocks, wealth management products and other asset management products than in the same period last year.
